actual: Formal P6 autocycle L2 run completed 2096/2096 fits and D5 correctly failed closed. Seed 46 is rejected for 801741.SI because D4-02-A computes expected covariance as (nu*R + posterior_mass*second_moment)/(nu + posterior_mass). The approved GaussianHMM profile uses covars_weight=1.0 and hmmlearn 0.3.3 actually divides diagonal covariance by max(covars_weight-1,0)+posterior_mass = posterior_mass. The mismatched audit denominator produces a false 0.0279676 M-step residual above the approved 0.02 threshold even though raw covariance matches the library update. Expected: replay the exact approved hmmlearn M-step denominator, preserve nu=1 prior numerator and all existing covariance bounds/zero-anomaly/tolerance semantics, add direct regression evidence, and do not alter occupancy, D5/D6, seeds, model or READY contracts.
